name: Ligato VPP Agent
description: Control plane management agent for FD.io's VPP. A set of VPP-specific plugins using CN-Infra framework to interact with other services/microservices in the cloud.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Pre-built Docker images ligato/vpp-agent and ligato/dev-vpp-agent on DockerHub, with both standard and ARM64 variants available.

eval_notes: Go-based management agent for VPP data plane. Good for testing cloud-native VNF management scenarios. Pre-built Docker images with ARM64 support. Integrates with etcd and Kafka.
